features: Key Applications: Hyperconverged Infrastructure, Scale-Out Object Storage, Back-up & Recovery
Key Features: Two hot-pluggable systems (nodes) in a 2U form factor. Each node supports the following:
Dual Socket E2 Intel® Xeon® 6 6700 series processors with E-cores up to 250W with air cooling or 330W with liquid cooling
Up to 16 DIMMs supporting up to 4TB DDR5-6400 in 1DPC
Flexible networking with OCP 3.0 AIOM slot
Up to 2 PCIe 5.0 x8 LP + 1 PCIe 5.0 x16 LP slots
Internal PCIe 5.0 for 2x NVMe M.2 support onboard
Optional 4x NVMe M.2 support onboard with built-in HW RAID1 via SCC-A2NM2241GH-B1
Up to 6 front hot-swap 3.5" NVMe/SAS drive bays
